title: What Happens in the Workshop
prompt: Assigning a name INSIDE a function makes a new, private copy. Predict what the outside still holds.

rounds.code:
power = 100
def drain():
    power = 5
drain()
print(power)
rounds.explain: Assigning `power` inside drain() made a NEW local that vanished when the function ended. The global outside is still 100 — this is the surprise scope sets for beginners.
